capabilities: Rename template files with previewed Markdown link updates
Create and rename category indexes, updating Base link filters
Add tags to notes or preview vault-wide tag renames
Edit template category, tag and prefix properties
disambiguation: Not a general category browser or template creator; it is a consistency workbench that previews and applies renames across template files, category indexes, tags and filename prefixes.
extras: Initial release is desktop-only; Windows, macOS and mobile are not runtime-tested. Renames are previewed and rolled back on failure, but no backup files are created. Custom scripts, search queries and other plugins' saved template-path settings are not rewritten.
problem: Template filenames, category properties, tags and filename prefixes are independent names that must be tracked and renamed separately, with no preview of what a rename changes.

relations.evidence: Executing templates containing <% ... %> requires Templater to be installed and enabled.

summary: Dockable workbench for managing category indexes, templates, note prefixes and tags, with previewed renames and rollback on failure.
